confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge, not live listings or booking pages. July is low (rainy) season, so accommodation reflects off-season rates; dorm and guesthouse prices vary most. Cocktail and wine are set from price ratios to the beer anchor (about 2.5 and 2.3 times beer) because direct local knowledge of bar and by-the-glass prices is weaker. The FX value comes from web search summaries that cite the RBA exchange-rates page, not a direct page read.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: a northern Thai provincial tourism hub priced below Bangkok and Phuket tourist-area levels, benchmarked against comparable Thai and mainland Southeast Asian tourist cities with similar budget-to-mid-range demand.
